title: ERP System Outage Response
description: ERP system outages affecting food production and distribution operations
triggers: Complete ERP outage affecting production and distribution
immediate_actions: Assess impact on food production and distribution operations
Notify Coastal Foods IT Operations team
Implement manual ERP procedures if needed
Contact production management for operational impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review ERP application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to ERP systems
resolution_steps: Restart ERP services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply ERP patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with ERP vendor for complex issues
verification: Test ERP functionality for production and distribution
Confirm with production staff that system is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Coastal Foods IT Operations
special_considerations: Production-impacting ERP incidents are P1 regardless of number of affected users
ERP is critical for food production and distribution
Manual procedures may impact food safety and distribution timelines
Coordinate with production management for minimal disruption
